details: Independent source review e3fdac67: ScopedStopApplication resolve_session uses nonblocking lock before stop(lock_wait). During in-progress handoff it returns Busy/scope_unavailable without recording hold, so expected wait-for-handoff then durable hold never occurs. Source refs scoped_stop/mcp_stop.rs70, scoped_stop.rs357/554. Minimal fix under one waiting gate: verify exact mapping/instance/scope and install hold; no reentrant lock or skipped imported-scope checks. Regression through actual MCP port with fake handoff barrier; read-port itself supported. Tesla same session owns fix; no native replay.
